name: Rolex Sydney Hobart 2026 — Virtual
description: Virtual edition of the Rolex Sydney Hobart Yacht Race: 628 nm from Sydney Harbour down the NSW coast, across Bass Strait to Tasman Island and up the Derwent to Hobart. Start 02:00 UTC (13:00 AEDT) Sat 26 Dec 2026 with the real fleet. The virtual start line is set just outside the Heads. East Australian Current and Bass Strait weather do the sorting; hug the rhumb line or chase the current offshore. Polar: Class40 (meltemus.com) at 90%; everyone sails the same numbers.
